hotels.vendor_name: Ka La'i Waikiki Beach, LXR Hotels & Resorts
hotels.title: Hawaii Luxury Apartment-Style Retreat Steps from Waikiki Beach with Daily Breakfast & Infinity Pool
hotels.description: This Waikiki hideaway sits just moments from the beckoning shoreline, with sun-soaked sands and gentle Pacific swells within easy reach. Sprawl out in residential-style rooms and suites where full kitchens and floor-to-ceiling views make you feel more local than tourist. Diamond Head's iconic silhouette looms three miles away, while Luxury Row's glittering boutiques await nearby. Between the infinity pool's liquid edge and the resort's laidback rhythm, leaving feels optional. Bloom Cafe & Restaurant's garden-wrapped tables serve up island-grown everything from dawn till dark, while poolside service offers refreshing drinks and tasty snacks. To fully unwind, let your worries melt away with indulgent in-room spa treatments, or order a romantic meal straight to your suite to enjoy on your private balcony. Step outside and Waikiki Beach becomes your personal playground - surfboards waiting, sunsets guaranteed and that infectious beachfront buzz humming all around. Hunt down hidden gem bars and Honolulu's best eats, snorkel Hanauma Bay's crystal waters, catch live music at sunset as the sun melts into the Pacific, or simply wander wherever the aloha spirit leads.

hotels.title: Hawaii Beachcomber by OUTRIGGER Escape Overlooking Waikiki Beach
hotels.description: Steps from one of the world's most famous shorelines, you'll find Hawaii's first and only craft hotel, brought to you by the iconic OUTRIGGER Hotels & Resorts. Placing you just moments from Waikiki Beach and the palm-lined Kalakaua Avenue, Honolulu's best is right on your doorstep. Curated by local artists and reflecting the island's natural landscapes and rich culture, the hotel's interiors feature surf photography and indigenous art that embody the laidback Hawaiian lifestyle. You'll be spoiled with the luxe facilities onsite, including a glorious pool, sun-drenched deck and its very own OUTRIGGER Theater, showcasing acrobatics and soul-stirring music. Begin each day with artisanal coffee and Acai bowls at Hawaiian Aroma Caffé, which doubles as a cocktail bar, and sample one of the 35+ craft beers on tap at Maui Brewing Co. - Hawaii’s largest craft brewery.

hotels.title: Modern Waikiki Escape near Kalakaua Avenue with Daily US$25 Dining Credit & Welcome Cocktails
hotels.description: Step into the heart of Waikiki and discover this island haven, extensively revamped in 2024 and just steps from the world-renowned Waikiki Beach and iconic International Market Place. Known for its pristine white-sand beaches, stunning views of Diamond Head and lively nightlife, you’ll be immersed in the vibrant pulse of the city - a bucket-list destination that effortlessly blends natural beauty with bustling urban fun. Indulge your senses across the hotel’s onsite eateries: at Appetito Craft Pizza & Wine Bar, savour handcrafted Neapolitan-style pizza paired with a selection of boutique wines. For a change of pace, head to Tanaka of Tokyo, where skilled teppanyaki chefs prepare a sizzling feast of Japanese steak and seafood right at your table. Join a special lei-making class or take your pilates practice to paradise with scheduled hotel activities. Whether you’re unwinding by the pool or soaking in the lively island atmosphere, OUTRIGGER Waikīkī Paradise Hotel is the perfect gateway to experiencing the best of both worlds.

hotels.title: Boutique Hawaii Oasis in Waikiki with Onsite Dining & Outdoor Pool
hotels.description: Live the Waikiki experience at this stylish boutique retreat, the ideal launchpad for your island adventures. Set in the heart of Waikiki, the hotel is just moments from the crystal-clear waters of the Pacific Ocean - perfect for swimming and snorkelling. Romer House Waikiki exceeds your every expectation, with a serene wading pool surrounded by softly upholstered daybeds and relaxed sling deck chairs. Indulge in a modern twist on Hawaiian cuisine at 855-ALOHA, where fusion-inspired dishes and signature cocktails are served in a tranquil, open-air setting with nightly live entertainment. Venture out to explore Kalakaua Avenue, lined with local boutiques and eateries, visit the Duke Kahanamoku Statue, take a surfing lesson or explore O’ahu’s diverse attractions.

hotels.title: Waikiki Beachside Escape near Kalākaua Avenue with Poolside Bar, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Set moments from Waikiki Beach, this design-led retreat places you near Kalākaua Avenue’s flagship boutiques and the surf breaks of Queen’s Beach. Rooms pair mid-century lines with island textures and many feature private lanais for trade-wind breezes. A landscaped pool courtyard anchors the property, with cabanas and a hot tub for post-swim downtime. Start the day with locally roasted coffee and pastries at B-Side Coffee Bar and end it by the poolside speakeasy Lost & Found. Redfish Poke serves onsite Hawaiian-inspired plates with fresh seafood and seasonal produce, as well as craft beers and signature cocktails. Head to Kapi‘olani Park for Diamond Head views and oceanfront trails, or Honolulu Zoo and the Waikiki Aquarium sit within an easy stroll for a culture-and-nature fix.
